general.hero_summary: Computer Science & Mathematics graduate (2026) managing enterprise IT infrastructure and centralized databases for 1,200+ users across regional branches. Proven track record architecting multi-tenant SaaS routing platforms, securing production Linux/Windows environments, and delivering cybersecurity instruction.
hero_points: Oversees network operations, enterprise databases, and system security for 1,200+ users across multiple regional branches.
Architected multi-tenant SaaS routing platforms, luxury e-commerce portals, and enterprise sync systems.
Delivers hands-on cybersecurity and software development instruction for global and national tech programs.
general.about_intro: I bridge enterprise system administration, production full-stack software engineering, and defensive cybersecurity. Having managed real-world infrastructure for 1,200+ users and designed multi-tenant lab routing architectures, I build resilient systems with security and operational reliability from day one.
general.about_main: In my role as System Administrator at Shalaby Lab, I ensure uninterrupted IT operations and database integrity across multiple regional branches. That hands-on reality-where misconfigurations, network bottlenecks, or security lapses directly affect healthcare operations-shapes everything I code and design. When I architect SaaS platforms or automate server management, I design for granular RBAC, strict tenant isolation, and automated failover.
general.about_support: Alongside systems engineering, I instruct cybersecurity and software development for US and Egyptian national initiatives (DECI & DEMI). Breaking down complex concepts like ethical hacking, network protocols, cryptography, and application security for aspiring engineers continuously reinforces my own technical depth and clear operational communication.
general.goal_text: Open to enterprise infrastructure, full-stack software engineering, and cybersecurity engineering opportunities where high reliability, secure architecture, and operational excellence are paramount.
general.contact_summary: Whether you are looking for an experienced System Administrator, a Full-Stack Engineer who understands enterprise infrastructure, or an Instructor to lead technical security programs, let's connect.
general.footer_copy: Mohamed Magdi Elhemaly - System Administrator, Full-Stack Developer & Cybersecurity Instructor.
